subject: Kenya's new US Level 3 will probably outlast its nine Ebola cases: Uganda is still at Level 4, 89 days after declaring its outbreak over
preview: The US cut Tanzania to Level 2 on 16 Oct and raised Kenya to Level 3 on 19 Oct; Rwanda is at Level 3 and Uganda at Level 4 (State Department, read 25 Oct).
